test_vectorized_func: test the vectorized_func by passing numpy arrays and scalars to verify element-wise multiplication results
test_type_selection: test selective_func to verify it dispatches to the correct branch based on numpy array dtype
test_trivial_broadcasting: test vectorized_is_trivial to detect whether numpy array broadcasting is C-trivial, F-trivial, or non-trivial
test_passthrough_arguments: test vec_passthrough to verify non-vectorized arguments pass through correctly alongside vectorized numpy arrays
test_vectorized_noreturn: test add_to to verify a vectorized function with no return value accumulates values into a NonPODClass instance
